result.paraphrase: An easy way to expand your device’s storage with fast extra space. The SanDisk Ultra Fit USB 3.1 Flash Drive offers performance that can transfer a full-length movie up to 15 times faster than standard USB 2.0 drives. Thanks to its compact, streamlined build, it’s designed to stay plugged in. Features: A compact, plug-and-stay high-speed USB 3.1 flash drive ideal for adding storage to laptops, game consoles, in-car audio, and more; simple, fast way to add up to 256GB of storage; read speeds up to 130MB/s; write speeds up to 15X faster than standard USB 2.0 drives; move a full-length movie to the drive in under 30 seconds. Specifications: available capacity 128GB; performance/speed up to 130MB/s read; dimensions 19.1 x 15.9 x 8.8 mm / 0.75 x 0.63 x 0.35 in (LxWxH); operating temperature 0 C to 35 C; storage temperature -10 C to 70 C; compatibility USB 3.1, backward compatible with USB 3.0 and USB 2.0; package content 1 x SANDISK 128GB CZ430 ULTRA FIT USB 3.1; package content 58 x SANDISK 128GB CZ430 ULTRA FIT USB 3.1 (SDCZ430-128G)
